tasks.title: Add message creation endpoint with validation
tasks.description: Implement POST /api/v1/messages endpoint with full validation flow including institution and message definition lookups
acceptanceCriteria: Valid message request returns 200 with message ID and DRAFT status
Missing required fields returns 400 with MSG-001 error in Persian
Invalid amount (zero or negative) returns 400 with MSG-001 error
Invalid network returns 400 with MSG-003 error
Invalid sender institution returns 400 with MSG-010 error
Invalid receiver institution returns 400 with MSG-011 error
Institution-network mismatch returns 400 with MSG-012 error

tasks.title: Add message validation service
tasks.description: Implement field-level validation with comprehensive error collection and Persian messages
acceptanceCriteria: Returns Persian error messages for all validation failures
Validates network is SWIFT or SEPA
Collects all validation errors and returns them together

tasks.title: Add message entity and repository
tasks.description: Create JPA entity and repository for message persistence with JSONB support for validation errors
acceptanceCriteria: Message entity maps to messages table
Status field supports DRAFT and VALIDATION_FAILED

tasks.title: Add message ID generation
tasks.description: Implement deterministic message ID generation with daily sequential numbering

tasks.title: Add error handling and global exception handler
tasks.description: Implement consistent error responses with Persian messages for all validation failures
acceptanceCriteria: Error response includes error code, field, and message

tasks.title: Add tests for message creation
tasks.description: Write unit, integration, and controller tests for all acceptance criteria
acceptanceCriteria: MessageValidationServiceTest covers all validation scenarios (10 tests)
MessageControllerTest covers all HTTP scenarios (6 tests)
All tests use proper assertions and Persian message validation
